verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents a public API covering an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, the Agent API (web-grounded answers with citations, multi-turn context, structured output, model fallback, versioned profiles, sandbox tool), the Search API and embeddings. A live probe confirms a published openapi.json and an llms.txt docs index. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API usage, and evidence that consumer-app features such as Library and Labs are exposed through the API.
